definitions.explanation: An arranged serving of various types of sliced raw fish presented together on a plate or platter, typically ordered at restaurants or prepared for special occasions.

examples.japanese: {刺身盛|さしみも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。

examples.english: What fish are in today's sashimi platter?

examples.japanese: ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧な{刺身盛|さしみも}り{合|あ}わせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いていた→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: The year-end party course came with a luxurious assorted sashimi platter.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ (sashimi; raw sliced fish) + ⟦{盛|も}り→盛り：13696_mori⟧ (serving; arrangement). Often written as {刺身|さしみ}{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ for the full form. A staple item at izakaya and Japanese restaurants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刺身盛|さしみも}り{合|あ}わせ: assorted sashimi platter (full form)
- {三点盛|さんてんも}り: three-variety sashimi plate
- {五点盛|ごてんも}り: five-variety sashimi plate
- {刺身盛|さしみも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: order a sashimi platter

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: sashimi — raw fish sliced for eating
- ⟦{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ→盛り合わせ：21762_moriawase⟧: assortment; assorted plate — used for other foods too
- {舟盛|ふなも}り: boat-shaped sashimi platter — sashimi arranged on a boat-shaped wooden plate, a premium presentation
